''See also: [[Lindon Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Lindon, also known as Wei Shi Lindon or [[Wei Shi Lindon Arelius]], is a powerful [[sacred artist]] who originated from the [[Wei clan]] in [[Sacred Valley]]. Initially identified as an [[Unsouled]] with a [[wooden badge]] and no [[madra]], he eventually rose through various ranks of [[advancement]], progressing from [[Iron]] to [[Jade]], [[Lowgold]], and ultimately reaching the status of a [[Sage]] and [[Lord]]. His path is deeply connected to the [[Path of Black Flame]], and he possesses a [[spirit]] characterized by [[hunger madra]]. Throughout his journey, he has navigated complex political landscapes, serving as an adopted [[disciple]] of the [[Arelius family]] and representing the [[Akura clan]]. Lindon has demonstrated significant mastery over [[sacred arts]], including [[Soulsmithing]] and the use of specialized techniques like the [[Hollow Domain]]. His influence extends across multiple realms, including the [[Blackflame Empire]], the [[Seishen Kingdom]], and [[Threshold]], where he has interacted with high-ranking entities such as Underlords, [[Monarchs]], and [[Abidan]]. He is also associated with the control of the [[labyrinth]] and holds a connection to the [[Slumbering Wraith]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Wei Shi Lindon is a tall, broad-shouldered man with short black hair and a rough face. His eyes have undergone various transformations, ranging from solid black with red irises to blue crystals with white circles, and eventually becoming black-and-white. He often wears modified [[Skysworn armor]] or robes of black, white, and purple, and he possesses a distinctive white [[Remnant]] arm.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Lindon is characterized by an iron will and an unhealthy obsession with [[advancement]]. He is a protective companion to [[Yerin]] and [[Eithan]], often feeling responsible for the lives of his allies. While he can be a domineering presence when wielding [[Blackflame]], he also prefers to keep a low profile.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As a practitioner of the [[Path of Twin Stars]], Lindon utilizes two cores to manage different types of [[madra]], including [[pure madra]] and [[Blackflame]]. He is a skilled [[Soulsmith]] capable of forging [[constructs]] and uses various techniques such as the [[Burning Cloak]], [[Empty Palm]], [[dragon]]'s breath, and the [[Hollow Domain]]. Furthermore, as a [[Sage]], he wields the authority of the [[Void Icon]] to manipulate empty spaces and can [[Consume]] energy from others.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Heaven's Glory Disciple}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Wei Shi Lindon is an eight-year-old [[disciple]] of the [[Heaven's Glory]] School who is currently at the [[Foundation stage]] of [[advancement]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c12">''Unsouled'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c13">''Unsouled'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c20">''Unsouled'', chapter 20</ref> Possessing [[pure madra]], he secured a victory against [[Kazan Ma Deret]] by incapacitating his opponent.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c14">''Unsouled'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c15">''Unsouled'', chapter 15</ref> Dressed in white [[disciple]]'s clothes, Lindon carries a wooden [[ward key]], [[boundary flags]], and [[Suriel's warm marble]] in his pack.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17">''Unsouled'', chapter 17</ref> He utilizes a boundary formation of his own composed of purple banners.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17" /> While his body has not yet reached the [[Iron stage]], he carries a [[halfsilver]] dagger and once asked [[Yerin]] if she could keep him alive.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c18">''Unsouled'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c19">''Unsouled'', chapter 19</ref> By using an [[ancestral orus fruit]], he activated both the [[White Fox]] boundary and a [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c19" /> Lindon employs the [[Heart of Twin Stars]] [[cycling technique]] to split his core into two dim, blue-white balls of light, allowing him to direct [[madra]] into one core while keeping the other closed.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c20" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Fisher Apprentice}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|As a newly adopted Fisher, Lindon has been working for [[Fisher Gesha]] for nearly two weeks while learning the art of [[Forging]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c12">''Soulsmith'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13">''Soulsmith'', chapter 13</ref> His [[madra]] consists almost entirely of [[water]], and he possesses a red [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c12" /> Five days after his release from the [[Sandvipers]], Lindon visited [[Yerin]], though he had previously been sneaking around the Sandviper camp.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13" /> While present in the mines, he was held as a prisoner forced to use [[mining equipment]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14">''Soulsmith'', chapter 14</ref> Lindon, who refers to [[Eithan]] as elder brother, is a [[Copper stage]] practitioner with a knotted [[madra]] flow and a [[Path manual]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c15">''Soulsmith'', chapter 15</ref> Having split his core himself as a defensive measure, he is blind and covered in bruises and scrapes from a fight.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c15" /> Despite having a cracked rib and swollen, useless legs that have prevented him from walking for days, he used his spare [[madra]] to Forge the [[Sylvan]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c16">''Soulsmith'', chapter 16</ref> His [[fortress]] is constructed from [[Remnant]] pieces like shimmering green limbs and bright blue shells, which he cleans using a [[spider-construct]]'s claws.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c16" /> Armed with a cloth-wrapped Sandviper [[stinger]], he has raised his second core to [[Copper]] and is currently forging [[scales]] to advance his core.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c16" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Copper Stage Soulsmith}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Having successfully transitioned to [[Iron]], Lindon shouts for others to wait.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c17">''Soulsmith'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c18">''Soulsmith'', chapter 18</ref> The [[Soulsmith]] possesses a Bloodforged body and a shattered core.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19">''Soulsmith'', chapter 19</ref> Probabilistic calculations regarding Wei Shi Lindon's future suggest he will likely fill a core with the [[Path of the Stellar Spear]], though there is also a high probability he will die after wounding [[Jai Long]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19" /> While there is a low probability that he will be executed by the [[Jai clan]] for failing to find a suitable [[Path]] for his [[Path of Twin Stars]], Lindon instead devises a weapon specifically designed to counter [[Jai Long]]'s spear and ultimately dies of his wounds following their duel.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19" /> Wearing an iron badge around his neck and holding the spear of his ancestor, Lindon faces questions from [[Eithan]] regarding whether he can keep up with his goal.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c20">''Soulsmith'', chapter 20</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Utilizing a [[cycling technique]] taught to him by [[Eithan]], Lindon possesses a smoky gray crystal and a [[Blackflame core]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c14" /> His [[Blackflame madra]] is prepared to propel him forward after he successfully cleared the [[Enforcer Trial]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c14" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c15">''Blackflame'', chapter 15</ref> Following a path suitable for a heron to kill a lion, he maintains a contract with [[Orthos]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c15" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c16">''Blackflame'', chapter 16</ref> As an [[Iron]]-stage [[sword]] artist known as Wei Shi Lindon, he entered the [[Ruler Trial]] alongside [[Yerin]] by kneeling before the trial's tablet.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c16" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c17">''Blackflame'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c18">''Blackflame'', chapter 18</ref> In addition to his [[Twin Stars]] [[madra]], Lindon possesses [[Blackflame madra]] that he can withstand without dissolving.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c17" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c18" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Jade Stage Enforcer}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Wei Shi Lindon is a [[Jade stage]] practitioner who carries a jade badge.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c18" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c19">''Blackflame'', chapter 19</ref> While feeling the pain of venom working through [[Orthos]], his core flared with a dark and bloody light.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c19" /> He used a simple breathing [[technique]] to cycle and digest power, though he later employed a [[Striker technique]] that left him dizzy from the strain on his [[spirit]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c19" /> After finding [[Eithan]] at the edge of a cliff, Lindon revealed eyes resembling a [[death Remnant]] with [[blood]]-red rings and black surroundings.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c20">''Blackflame'', chapter 20</ref> Claiming to be on [[Arelius family]] business, Lindon and [[Yerin]] left the [[Sacred Valley]] to enter the [[Desolate Wilds]] after being adopted by a young [[Underlord]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c21">''Blackflame'', chapter 21</ref> Ultimately, Lindon has deviated from his primary course.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c21" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Lindon is a [[Gold stage]] Wei Shi who possesses the [[Eye of the Deep]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2">''Ghostwater'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c3">''Ghostwater'', chapter 3</ref> After stepping through a [[portal]] into a bubble of air, his [[madra channels]] shrieked in protest from the effort of forcing out [[dragon]]'s breath.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c3" /> Clad in a [[Burning Cloak]], the apprentice [[Soulsmith]] possesses a skeletal [[Remnant]] arm made of [[white madra]] and a core that contains almost nothing.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c4">''Ghostwater'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6">''Ghostwater'', chapter 6</ref> Despite having an inhuman right hand that would not obey him, he grabbed an old [[Remnant]] body and fled through the trees.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8">''Ghostwater'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c10">''Ghostwater'', chapter 10</ref> Although his dying [[pure core]] recovers at a snail's pace without assistance, Lindon can consume [[madra]] and has trained by [[cycling]] the energy of the sacred fish.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c9">''Ghostwater'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c10" /> He is capable of using [[dragon]]'s breath, the [[Striker technique]], [[hunger binding]], and [[Flowing Flame madra]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c10" /> While wearing a [[gold badge]] in the [[Monarch]]'s [[pocket world]], Lindon observed blue lights and silver [[scales]] near a bubble.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c10" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c11">''Ghostwater'', chapter 11</ref><ref {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Two weeks after reaching the [[Spirit Well]], Lindon advanced to [[Highgold]] in his [[pure core]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15">''Ghostwater'', chapter 15</ref> He utilizes a [[void key]] for item storage and employs the [[Soul Cloak]] [[technique]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16">''Ghostwater'', chapter 16</ref> While [[cycling]] [[fire and destruction aura]] from burning undergrowth, he uses [[Dream Well water]] to remain awake.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15" /> Lindon cycles power from the [[Life Well]] to [[Dross]] and launched a bolt of [[dragon]]'s fire at Harmony.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15" /> In possession of Suriel's marble, he is now approaching the [[Truegold]] stage.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16" /> As a person [[Yerin]] wants to reach, Lindon possesses a more dense [[Goldsign]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c17">''Ghostwater'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c18">''Ghostwater'', chapter 18</ref> Through his [[spiritual perception]], he can feel the armor draining Harmony's [[spirit]] and attention.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c18" /> Finally, he used the [[Soul Cloak]] along with his reinforced body to climb a cliff.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c19">''Ghostwater'', chapter 19</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|While [[cycling]] [[madra]] to his limb to prevent being lost to the [[wind]], Lindon utilized [[dragon]]'s breath in his left palm.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c4">''Underlord'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5">''Underlord'', chapter 5</ref> Relying almost entirely on [[Blackflame]], he has practiced the [[Heaven and Earth Purification Wheel]] for a year and a half as he attempts to master [[Soulsmithing]] alongside two [[Paths]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5" /> Having found a way to enhance his mind, Lindon possesses ghostwater and a [[Life Well]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c7">''Underlord'', chapter 7</ref> His [[void key]] contains [[Harmony's axe]], though his low supply of [[Spirit Well water]] has been used to push his [[pure core]] closer to [[Truegold]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c7" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8">''Underlord'', chapter 8</ref> His [[Blackflame core]] resembles a dark sun on one side of his [[spirit]], equal to a blue-white core.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8" /> After reaching the end of [[Truegold]] and opening his [[soulspace]], Lindon sat in the [[Night Wheel Valley]] forest.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c9">''Underlord'', chapter 9</ref> He was not involved in {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Lindon is a [[Blackflame]] boy who can gather and cycle [[Blackflame]] in his hand.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c13">''Underlord'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c18">''Underlord'', chapter 18</ref> While wielding [[Harmony's axe]] and unshaped [[pure madra]], he maintains a healthy lifeline.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c12">''Underlord'', chapter 12</ref> An apprentice of [[Eithan]] Arelius, Lindon was led by his mentor to [[Fisher Gesha]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c13" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14">''Underlord'', chapter 14</ref> He possesses a jagged, angular [[Remnant]] arm made of white material that was created alongside [[Fisher Gesha]] and repaired using [[hunger]] bindings from [[dreadbeasts]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c12" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14" /> Though this [[Remnant]] limb is losing its luster and is expected to be lost upon his [[advancement]] to [[Underlord]], he wears it alongside modified [[Skysworn armor]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15">''Underlord'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c17">''Underlord'', chapter 17</ref> As a member of the [[Skysworn]] who uses [[dream madra]], Lindon's concentration is enhanced by [[Dross]], and he has discovered the utility [[Dross]] provides to a [[Soulsmith]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c19">''Underlord'', chapter 19</ref> Cut off from the [[Arelius family]] and sought after for salvation by [[Akura Mercy]], Lindon carries a ball of [[gray soulfire]] within his [[spirit]] as he nears becoming an [[Underlord]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20">''Underlord'', chapter 20</ref> During combat, he can use a [[void key]] to pull out an axe or utilize a [[launcher construct]] cannon that is susceptible to being destroyed.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c19" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Known as the [[Blackflame]], Lindon wields an axe featuring a red gleaming edge and a long bone haft.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /> As a [[Truegold]], he possesses a [[white arm]] capable of cracking to spray [[madra]], though this [[Remnant]] limb is fractured and barely holding together.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /> He utilizes [[hunger binding]] in his arm and employs [[pure madra]] to bind [[Archstone]] fragments, often using ghostwater to assist with mental imaging during the forging process.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /> Through a [[soulfire transformation]], his [[Remnant]] arm is repaired into a pure white human arm while the [[soulfire]] also rebuilds his [[madra channels]] and strengthens his bones.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c21">''Underlord'', chapter 21</ref> After advancing to [[Underlord]], he uses [[Underlord]] [[madra]] to activate a [[binding]] on his axe and gains the [[spiritual perception]] of a [[Lord]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c21" /> Despite his [[Skysworn armor]] being cracked all over, Lindon is mentioned in relation to the [[tournament]] and is identified as [[Kelsa]]'s brother.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c21" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c22">''Underlord'', chapter 22</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Mentioned by [[Orthos]], Lindon is found sitting in a dungeon after being brought to [[Moongrave]] via the [[Sage]]'s transportation.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c1">''Uncrowned'', chapter 1</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c2">''Uncrowned'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c3">''Uncrowned'', chapter 3</ref> Having risen from the [[Blackflame territory]], he practices both an inherited [[fire and destruction]] [[Path]] alongside a [[pure madra]] [[Path]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c3" /> While being introduced to [[Mercy]]'s peers, he requested a [[parasite ring]], [[madra restoration pills]], and [[mental enhancement elixirs]] from an [[Akura servant]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c3" /> As a guest of [[Charity]], Lindon experienced quiet panic while she examined [[Dross]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4">''Uncrowned'', chapter 4</ref> He possesses [[Skysworn armor]] and keeps explosive [[constructs]] stored within his [[void key]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4" /> While practicing focused [[technique]] training, he sustained a gash in his lip.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c5">''Uncrowned'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c6">''Uncrowned'', chapter 6</ref> Now living in [[Moongrave]], Lindon uses [[pure madra]] to drown spiritual attacks directed at his core.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c7">''Uncrowned'', chapter 7</ref> An adopted member of the [[Arelius family]], he is a qualified participant in the [[Uncrowned]] [[tournament]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c8">''Uncrowned'', chapter 8</ref> After holding a [[construct]] that exploded, Lindon is staying in the [[Ninecloud Court]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c9">''Uncrowned'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c10">''Uncrowned'', chapter 10</ref> His breath locked in his chest as he competed in the [[tournament]] with the objective of destroying the black base dome or eliminating all [[black soldiers]] to lead the white army to victory.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c10" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c11">''Uncrowned'', chapter 11</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Having trained at the Akura family, Lindon moves with speed and grace using his [[Soul Cloak]] while wearing their [[sacred artist]]'s robes.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c14" /> He reinforces his arm with the [[Archstone]] and incorporates [[soulfire]] into his [[Empty Palm]] techniques, utilizing a [[Remnant hand]] to conduct these strikes.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c14" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15">''Uncrowned'', chapter 15</ref> To assist with his core, Lindon relies on [[Little Blue]] and can gather [[pure madra]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c14" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15" /> During combat, he uses [[hunger binding]] to weaken attacks and can allow the [[Path of Black Flame]] to bleed into his eyes.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15" /> After having his head torn off by Sophara's claws, Lindon reappeared on the beach following the battle.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15" /> Wearing a [[halfsilver badge]], he offered to fight the [[Monarch]] and drew on his fire [[Path]] to increase his heat tolerance.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c16">''Uncrowned'', chapter 16</ref> Lindon utilized a two-handed [[dragon]]'s breath attack, though he had to force his body to move like a puppet.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c16" /> His prize is an [[Iron Heart]] cast in dark gray metal that has integrated with his [[Iron body]], which can draw [[pure madra]] from him.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c19">''Uncrowned'', chapter 19</ref> While watching [[Yerin]]'s face closely, the rival of [[Yerin]] utilized a shield that can take a spiritual form alongside [[Wavedancer]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c19" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20">''Uncrowned'', chapter 20</ref> He uses [[soulfire]] control to weaken [[sword]]-[[aura]] and employs a [[technique]] from [[Eithan]] to blast [[pure madra]] from his body as spiritual armor.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|After his [[madra]] was affected by a foreign will, Lindon was eliminated from the [[Uncrowned King]] [[tournament]] and failed to notice the [[Dragon King]]'s departure.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c2">''Wintersteel'', chapter 2</ref> While staying in a room within the Akura family's amethyst spire, which he accessed using a scripted card, Lindon was a [[Copper]] during Suriel's visit.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3">''Wintersteel'', chapter 3</ref> While sitting cross-legged on his bed, he sensed [[blood madra]] within [[Yerin's spirit]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3" /> As a companion to [[Eithan]] and [[Yerin]], Lindon watched the fights from the [[Akura audience platform]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c4">''Wintersteel'', chapter 4</ref> He practiced the [[Heaven and Earth Purification Wheel]] [[technique]] and possessed a [[Remnant hand]] with five white fingers.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5">''Wintersteel'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6">''Wintersteel'', chapter 6</ref> While watching the [[Uncrowned]] matches with [[Yerin]] and [[Mercy]], Lindon noticed that the [[Ninecloud Soul]] had skated over his fourth-round opponent's name.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7">''Wintersteel'', chapter 7</ref> Following instructions from [[Northstrider]], Lindon expressed interest in joining the Akura operation near the [[Wandering Titan]] to seek out enemies for training.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7" /> Lindon felt embarrassed to be the only one who had not progressed, even though he could use a [[void key]] to open a midair door.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8">''Wintersteel'', chapter 8</ref> During a match against [[Yerin]], Lindon summoned the [[Ninecloud Soul]], revealing that he has two spirits while wearing a blue-white [[Soul Cloak]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c9">''Wintersteel'', chapter 9</ref> As he was being prepared for battle against enemy Underlords, Lindon utilized a [[pure madra]] [[veil]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c9" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c10">''Wintersteel'', chapter 10</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|While working as a [[Soulsmith]] when missions are unavailable, Lindon utilizes a green [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]] and carries a message-receiving [[construct]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c12">''Wintersteel'', chapter 12</ref> Accompanied by a blue [[spirit]] perching on his shoulder, he uses [[Little Blue]] to treat injuries and maintains a fever for points.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c12" /> As the leader of a group that successfully drove [[Truegold]] cultists away from a tower, Lindon commanded [[Dross]] to relay his plan to Pride.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c12" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13">''Wintersteel'', chapter 13</ref> During combat, he utilizes a sparkling blue chalk [[gatestone]] and employs [[earth aura]] and [[madra]] to form blades from loose stones.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13" /> He combines [[Ruler]] and [[Striker techniques]] to cause physical and spiritual [[destruction]] while wearing a prototype armor cobbled from [[Skysworn]] and [[Seishen Kingdom]] plates.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13" /> Although this armor can activate six full-body [[Enforcer techniques]] at once, Lindon's [[pure madra]] empowered by [[Little Blue]] interferes with its function.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13" /> After leaping forward in combat, Lindon was eventually eliminated from the [[tournament]] matches and failed to beat his opponent under those conditions.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c14">''Wintersteel'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c16">''Wintersteel'', chapter 16</ref> Despite his elimination, he remained interested only in [[Yerin]] and believed [[Mercy]] and [[Min Shuei]] could win.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c14" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c17">''Wintersteel'', chapter 17</ref> While crouched on a [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]], Lindon faced a dangerous situation where his safety depended on [[Yerin]] winning.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c17" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c21">''Wintersteel'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c22">''Wintersteel'', chapter 22</ref> He later fought [[Naian Blackflame]] using [[dragon]]'s breath from his palm, projecting a domineering and aggressive impression while holding [[Blackflame]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18">''Wintersteel'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19">''Wintersteel'', chapter 19</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|After checking his [[void key]], Lindon became unresponsive due to a vision in which he attempted to separate his own memories from those of the [[Dreadgod]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c24" /> While standing among a circle of onlookers, Lindon was noted as being part of [[Malice]]'s plans and having been protected by Sophara.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c25">''Wintersteel'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26">''Wintersteel'', chapter 26</ref> Observing the battle involving [[Fury]], Lindon moved to join the gang and used [[spiritual perception]] while [[cycling]] his [[madra]] to its limit.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27">''Wintersteel'', chapter 27</ref> Lindon barreled into Sophara, whom he had trained against six hundred and forty-four times.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27" /> While maintaining a [[pure madra]] field that made his eyes look like deep blue gems, Lindon used a [[Forged palm]] of [[pure madra]] to wipe out Sophara's [[spirit]] with an [[Enforcer technique]] stronger than her own.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref> As his eyes transformed into blue crystal, a black hole swallowed the sky directly above him.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28" /> While on the [[cloudship]] dock with [[Eithan]], Lindon wore a [[wintersteel badge]] featuring his old [[Unsouled symbol]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Lindon is a [[Sage]] who shares a personal [[cloud fortress]] with [[Yerin]], whom he is accompanied by.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c2">''Bloodline'', chapter 2</ref> A standout participant in the [[Uncrowned King]] [[tournament]], he possesses a perception more highly trained than the average [[Underlord]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c3">''Bloodline'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4">''Bloodline'', chapter 4</ref> He can sense distortions in space and things that [[Yerin]] cannot, and he is capable of draining souls by tightening his grip with his [[Remnant hand]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4" /> After activating a [[script-circle]] to lift protections, he felt responsible for the lost lives of the [[Akura Golds]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4" /> Despite preferring to keep a low profile, Lindon utilizes a [[fortress]] that employs security circles to disperse hostile [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c5">''Bloodline'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c6">''Bloodline'', chapter 6</ref> Upon landing on a snowy mountainside near [[Mount Samara]], he wore a [[wintersteel badge]] and refrained from using his [[Burning Cloak]] to close distances.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c6" /> While inquiring about the [[Wei clan]] exiles, he absorbed a [[Striker technique]] into his [[hunger arm]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c6" /> He is a tall individual with red-and-black eyes, a pale right hand, and wears robes of black, white, and purple adorned with a [[shadesilk ribbon]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c7">''Bloodline'', chapter 7</ref> His badge bears the [[Unsouled symbol]], and he once gripped an [[Enforcer]] by the neck.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c7" /> As a [[Lord]] in a realm beyond [[Gold]], he currently possesses the spiritual strength of a [[Truegold]] at the [[Lowgold]] level.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c8">''Bloodline'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c9">''Bloodline'', chapter 9</ref>}}

15</ref> After activating a [[viewing construct]] to see behind him, [[Lindon's madra]] became disordered.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c15" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c16">''Bloodline'', {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|After advancing to the Overlord stage and returning functional [[constructs]] to his [[void key]], Lindon is perceived by [[Jai Long]] as a [[Sage of Twin Stars]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18" /> While his future self possesses the ability to forge a weapon with the power of a [[Dreadgod]], Lindon rose on his cloud near the halo of light surrounding [[Mount Samara]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c19">''Bloodline'', chapter 19</ref> He caught [[Yerin]]'s arm to pull her onto his cloud, but his vision blanked out as [[madra]] streamed from both her and [[Eithan]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c19" /> Lindon used his [[Soul Cloak]] to remain standing and opened his [[void key]], knowing he needed to hit the [[Titan]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c19" /> Despite straining his [[madra channels]], he utilized the [[Consume]] [[technique]] to drain energy from the [[Titan]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c20">''Bloodline'', chapter 20</ref> Lindon suffered aftereffects from consuming too much of the [[Titan]], which resulted in his arm becoming strained and cracked from absorbing the power.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c21">''Bloodline'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c22">''Bloodline'', chapter 22</ref> Having absorbed appetites from the [[Wandering Titan]], he was addressed as Wei Shi Lindon by [[Elder Whisper]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c22" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|While attempting to repair [[Dross]], Lindon marched into the half-destroyed [[Tomb]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c3">''Reaper'', chapter 3</ref> He previously discovered an alliance of five factions that formed around the emergence of the [[Transcendent Ruins]] several years prior.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c4">''Reaper'', chapter 4</ref> Emitting blue-white [[pure madra]], Lindon possesses the ability to command the Book to release [[Mercy]], an entity whose Book he wishes to study.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c4" /> Driven by an unhealthy obsession with [[advancement]], he frequently experiences changes in his eye color.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c4" /> After sensing approaching cloudships before they were visible, he was able to see the Emperor's vessel.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c5">''Reaper'', chapter 5</ref> Now a twenty-year-old [[Sage]] and Overlord, Lindon reached the [[Sage]] stage while at the Overlord level and had previously summoned an [[Icon]] during his time as an [[Underlord]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c5" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c6">''Reaper'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c11">''Reaper'', chapter 11</ref> His specific [[Icon]] is the [[Void Icon]], and he has taught students a spiritual [[Enforcer technique]] known as the [[Heart of Twin Stars]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7">''Reaper'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c8">''Reaper'', chapter 8</ref> Lindon's right arm consists of flesh stitched together with [[hunger madra]] from dreadbeast cores, and though he addressed [[Eithan]] as [[Archlord]], he is considered inexperienced at recognizing certain workings of authority.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c8" /> Seeking comfort in the warmth of Suriel's marble, he felt [[Eithan's madra]] flood into his [[spirit]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c8" /> After being brought to the second floor of his house on [[Windfall]], Lindon—who was responsible for [[Dross]]'s evolution in the [[Ghostwater facility]]—began to suspect someone else might be in the [[labyrinth]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c9">''Reaper'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c10">''Reaper'', chapter 10</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|While waiting outside a chamber filled with raging, deadly blades, Lindon carries sufficient supplies to function as both a [[Soulsmith]] and a refiner.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c13">''Reaper'', chapter 13</ref> He possesses the ability to sense [[void keys]] and can run his [[madra]] through them.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c13" /> Utilizing a [[Hollow Domain]] and three compatible [[madra]] types, Lindon can dismantle the techniques of others, with his [[pure madra]] proving more effective at taking apart spiritual energy than [[destruction madra]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c14">''Reaper'', chapter 14</ref> His abilities include the use of [[soulfire]] and [[black dragon's breath]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c14" /> The individual known as Wei Shi Lindon is an acquaintance of Suriel.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c15">''Reaper'', chapter 15</ref> Enhanced by the [[Soul Cloak]], Lindon straps three launcher [[constructs]] to his left arm and uses a healing construct on [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c16">''Reaper'', chapter 16</ref> After switching to his [[Blackflame core]] while surrounded by [[water]], Lindon controls finger-thin beams of [[dragon]]'s breath and leverages his [[Void authority]] to affect portals made from the [[Path of the King’s Key]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17">''Reaper'', chapter 17</ref> During combat, he uses a [[Hollow Spear]] to strike [[Reigan Shen]] through the gut.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17" /> Following this, Lindon is left in a dire state with less than a third of his [[pure core]] remaining, low on [[madra]] and [[soulfire]], and suffering from the loss of an arm.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17" /> His [[soulfire]] appears as a dim candle, and he experiences a [[hunger aura]] while sensing something within the [[labyrinth]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Resembling Ozriel, Lindon possesses an iron will and [[madra]] that is pure yet tinged with the [[hunger]] of [[Subject One]].<ref hand]] of [[Subject One]] and capable of feeding on sensed power.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c2" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3">''Dreadgod'', chapter 3</ref> Because the [[Dreadgods]] remain, {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|As a young [[Void Sage]] with a connection to the [[Way]], Lindon possesses authority over manipulating empty spaces and keeps his [[hunger arm]] restrained by beyond [[Moongrave]], Lindon utilized his [[Hollow Domain]] to catch himself on his [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c16">''Dreadgod'', chapter 16</ref> The only student [[Kelsa]] has ever trained, Lindon is noted for his amazing [[Soulsmithing]] and provided her with protections and specific instructions regarding sleeping within scripted walls.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17">''Dreadgod'', chapter 17</ref> Lindon also presented [[Yerin]] with a balanced set of sealed treasures and prepared emergency measures for [[Orthos]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19">''Dreadgod'', chapter 19</ref> During a battle against the [[Silent King]], Lindon—whose mind-[[spirit]] was designed by [[Northstrider]]—erupted in a globe of [[pure madra]] fueled by his [[white hunger madra]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18" /> Having been assaulted by {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Lindon is characterized by white circles in his eyes and a chalk-white palm.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21">''Dreadgod'', chapter 21</ref> During combat, he shot [[Blackflame]] through the [[Dreadgod]]'s head, though he lacked the skill required to [[portal]] from Serpent’s [[Grave]] directly to [[Sacred Valley]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" /> He is capable of flight via an [[aura]] of [[wind]] and force and provided a [[void key]] to [[Orthos]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" /> Believing that the peak of [[Archlord]] brings one close to [[Sage]], he possesses both the [[Remnant of the Blood Sage]] and the script of the [[Rune Queen]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" /> Lindon can use the [[Void Icon]] to hide himself and others, and his power is sufficient to overcome temporary [[aura]] circles.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22">''Dreadgod'', chapter 22</ref> Feeling a sense of pride, he utilized a hammer to shape his will within the [[Soulforge]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23">''Dreadgod'', chapter 23</ref> Possessing the physical strength of a [[Herald]], he employs a full-body [[Enforcer technique]] and utilizes a [[flying sword]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23" /> His abilities include summoning [[constructs]] with an open [[void key]], weakening shadow blades through the [[Hollow Domain]], and releasing a [[dragon]]'s breath empowered by the [[Void Icon]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23" /> His temper can cause the [[Burning Cloak]] to burst involuntarily, yet he also possesses a cleansing tide of [[pure madra]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23" /> After picking up [[Mercy]], he flew [[Windfall]] north toward the [[Trackless Sea]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c24">''Dreadgod'', chapter 24</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Lindon possesses a repurposed [[pocket world]] and utilizes the [[Void Icon]] to monitor spatial stability.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2">''Waybound'', chapter 2</ref> To facilitate movement and travel, he uses [[wind]] [[aura]] to move [[Mercy]], employs the [[Soulforge]] to create a gateway, and wears various artifacts including [[Reigan Shen]]'s signet [[ring]], an ancient [[Monarch]]'s scepter, and a robe that belonged to [[Northstrider]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2" /> He guides his restorative [[aura]] with Suriel's marble and wears a crown that is the legacy of an ancient [[Monarch]] found in the [[labyrinth]], which he can easily repair if physically damaged.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2" /> Capable of using complex [[Ruler techniques]] effortlessly without a compatible [[Path]], Lindon is preparing to embed illusion [[constructs]] into the chamber floors.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2" /> After finishing the construction of [[Ghostwind Hall]], he demonstrates the ability to [[Consume]] [[Remnants]] while attempting to hide his frustration from [[Orthos]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3">''Waybound'', chapter 3</ref> Despite [[Reigan Shen]] wanting him and [[Yerin]] Arelius gone, Lindon stole the core to a [[pocket world]] from him.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c4">''Waybound'', chapter 4</ref> When using goldsteel tongs to grip a [[binding]] that burns against his eyes and spiritual senses, Lindon carries a main [[void key]] around his neck.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c4" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c5">''Waybound'', chapter 5</ref> He can adjust the flow of time and maintains a connection to the [[Void Icon]] while using the [[Bow of the Silent King]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c5" /> By forging an arrow using the [[binding]] at his bow's heart, he can use a [[Forger technique]] to release ten thousand identical arrows and move himself to the location of an arrow.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c5" /> Having recorded the [[Paths]] of Heaven from the bottom of the [[labyrinth]], Lindon possesses black-and-white [[Dreadgod]] eyes that are burning and inhuman, as well as a [[scale]] that can dissolve.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c7">''Waybound'', chapter 7</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Having consumed substances capable of destroying his soul, Lindon experienced a twitching in his right arm while using a quill and notebook to record notes.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c7" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c8">''Waybound'', chapter 8</ref> While hovering over [[Sacred Valley]], he felt the weight of a [[dragon]]'s charge as if it were a physical blow from a [[Dreadgod]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c9">''Waybound'', chapter 9</ref> Lindon prepared diets for [[Little Blue]] and [[Orthos]], kept the black [[dragon]] [[Remnants]] locked away, and utilized the power of the [[Void Icon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10">''Waybound'', chapter 10</ref> During a period of trading techniques with [[Northstrider]], Lindon was engaged in battle and stretched his perception toward the north.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c11">''Waybound'', chapter 11</ref> While concentrating [[madra]] in his left hand and using [[Northstrider]]'s [[Icon]], he bested [[Northstrider]], leaving his body ravaged and his will strained.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c11" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c12">''Waybound'', chapter 12</ref> As he fought [[Monarchs]] outside, Lindon used an item to help preserve [[Orthos]]'s memories.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c12" /> After emerging from the [[Trackless Sea]], Lindon was weak and potentially dead, as [[Little Blue]] was not yet strong enough to assist him.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13">''Waybound'', chapter 13</ref> Despite his condition, Lindon's sheer stubbornness allowed him to push through [[advancement]] realms, and he sent [[Yerin]] and Ziel to the battlefield.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c14">''Waybound'', chapter 14</ref> Struggling to stay awake from searing spiritual pain and the thunder of battle, he staggered through the [[Nethergate]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c15">''Waybound'', chapter 15</ref> With a body comparable to a [[Monarch]]'s that sits halfway between a [[Herald]] and a [[Dreadgod]], Lindon can read the feelings of others through their spirits.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c17">''Waybound'', chapter 17</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|While his [[madra channels]] run through his physical body, Lindon began to [[Consume]] by gripping a handful of [[scales]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> Despite having deep cores, he used an [[Empty Palm]] to weaken a [[Dreadgod]]'s blow and struck the [[Weeping Dragon]] across its belly with [[dragon]]'s breath.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> The [[Soulsmith]] who assembled the [[Penance arrow]] dropped his bow and suffered a complete loss of power and [[aura]] control, causing him to fall from the sky.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> Appearing as a dense core of black-and-[[white power]] beneath the [[dragon]]'s head, Lindon forced the Weeping [[Dragon's breath]] up into the sky before his power flickered out like a vanishing candle-flame.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> After giving Ziel, [[Mercy]], and [[Yerin]] a chance, Lindon's cores became completely empty and his presence felt weak.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20">''Waybound'', chapter 20</ref> The crafter of the [[Silent King]] [[Bow]] and its arrows used prototype [[Penance arrowheads]] to create three arrows, though he is ultimately needed to repair the [[Grand Oath Array]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /> On the verge of death during the battle, Lindon consumed something from the [[Dreadgod]]'s corpse and became powerful enough to defend his [[labyrinth]] against multiple [[Monarchs]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21">''Waybound'', chapter 21</ref> As his right arm of white flesh is transformed by a [[Dreadgod]]'s flesh and [[blood]], Lindon considered using [[Soulsmithing]] to remove damage and summoned [[Wavedancer]] from his [[void key]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" /> While Ozriel hoped to see him ascend, Lindon restored the house through a working of the [[Void Icon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c22">''Waybound'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23">''Waybound'', chapter 23</ref> Having taken more [[Dreadgod power]], the individual known to [[Northstrider]] as [[Ghost]] was looking for [[Emriss Silentborn]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Carrying [[Dross]], the current owner of his world is known as the [[Empty Ghost]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24">''Waybound'', chapter 24</ref> To prepare for a fight against [[Northstrider]] within the [[labyrinth]], Lindon performed a summoning with the intent to [[Consume]] the [[Monarch]] upon arrival.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24" /> Having already Consumed the [[Dreadgods]], he holds the arm of the [[Slumbering Wraith]] in his hand and is prepared to use force against [[Northstrider]] if persuasion fails, fearing a worst-case scenario where he must kill the [[Monarch]] himself.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24" /> As he attempts to enter the Book of Eternal Night, his body exists as a projection of his mind and [[spirit]], wielding power that is mostly stolen and sufficient to shake the fabric of the world.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c25">''Waybound'', chapter 25</ref> Despite reaching the level of [[Monarch]] in less than a decade, he never figured out how to fully repair the [[Array]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26">''Waybound'', chapter 26</ref> While fighting two [[Dreadgods]] and consuming energy from a meteor condensed from [[earth aura]], he used [[Wavedancer]] to deflect a [[Striker technique]] and met [[Reigan Shen]]'s pounce with a [[Soul Cloak]]-powered punch.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27">''Waybound'', chapter 27</ref> Having previously taken up most of the [[Monarch]]'s attention in fights with [[Malice]], Lindon felt [[Yerin]] advance and noted he would have to watch out for her if she joined the battle.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c28">''Waybound'', chapter 28</ref> During a battle involving the [[Phoenix]], he consumed a spear from the [[Bleeding Phoenix]] and used his ability to steal memories.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c29">''Waybound'', chapter 29</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30">''Waybound'', chapter 30</ref> He harassed the [[Wandering Titan]] with [[Blackflame]] and launched [[dragon]]'s breath at it, while also commanding the working around the [[Phoenix]]'s talon to break as he waited and questioned how much longer he must wait.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|While in [[Cradle]], Lindon experienced feelings of chaos and absence resulting from his connection to the [[Void Icon]] and an excessive connection to [[hunger]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c31">''Waybound'', chapter 31</ref> The [[Sage of Twin Stars]] can release a trickle of his spiritual sense and control [[wind]] [[aura]] over a [[courtyard]], though his time is limited.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c32">''Waybound'', chapter 32</ref> Using [[pure madra]] and the authority of the [[Void Icon]], he constructed a meeting space and utilized weapons pulled from his [[soulspace]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c33">''Waybound'', chapter 33</ref> After opening the [[Soulforge]] in the depths of the [[labyrinth]], he began using the weapon [[Genesis]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c34">''Waybound'', chapter 34</ref> Known as Wei Shi Lindon, he is capable of unleashing power that solidifies the air.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c35">''Waybound'', chapter 35</ref> During an arena game he proposed where hits are worth points, Lindon used storm [[madra]] to blast against Markuth's attack and punched through the man's defenses with his right hand.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c35" /> Clad in armor made from [[Dreadgods]] and a cloak of boiling liquid [[blood]], he summoned a blue-gold lightning [[flying sword]] from his [[soulspace]] to join nine other swords in formation behind him.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c35" /> As his fingers twitched as if possessed by spirits, he grabbed the [[Way]] to tear open a rift and marched into a tenuous [[portal]] to ascend from [[Cradle]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c35" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36">''Waybound'', chapter 36</ref> While ascending, he asked if they were heading to Suriel, a question that caused his heart to lift.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36" /> Having been away from [[Yerin]] and the others for almost two years, the possessor of a pair of [[Icons]] used his [[spiritual perception]] to measure the [[Grave]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c37">''Waybound'', chapter 37</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|While navigating the [[labyrinth]] alongside [[Eithan]], Lindon is known as [[Subject One]] and is observed draining a [[Remnant]] dry.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c2">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 3</ref> Expected to join [[Mercy]] and [[Fury]], Lindon has befriended [[Fury]] and previously utilized [[Dreadgod]] pieces to [[construct]] a bow.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 6</ref> He is characterized as someone who would seek to protect people while finding a way to kill the [[Fiend]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" /> After spending two days in the [[Grave]], the [[Cradle]] native Wei Shi Lindon finds his [[madra]] and spiritual sense in perfect condition despite [[Blackflame]] boiling in his [[spirit]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 7</ref> While defending [[Northgate]] against enemy forces on [[Threshold]], Lindon released his [[Hollow Domain]] by switching to his [[pure core]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" /> The [[Reaper]] identifies himself as Wei Shi Lindon before falling to earth amidst the screams of [[Dross]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" /> With a remade body, Lindon uses the [[Void Icon]] to suppress thoughts and serves as a representative for the newly formed [[Reaper Division]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" /> Lindon prepared emergency protections and weapons for his older sister, [[Kelsa]], before he ascended.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c8">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 8</ref> Following an explosion of [[pure madra]] over the clearing, Lindon offered to take Pride beyond the world and maintains a connection to Suriel.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c8" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c10">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 10</ref> Lindon has worked to upgrade the [[Grave]] by helping [[Eithan]] remodel its interior, all while seeking the source of [[OTEP]]'s information.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|After emerging from a [[Way-portal]] accompanied by warnings from the [[Abidan]], Lindon and [[Yerin]] found themselves in a new environment.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 13</ref> Lindon demonstrated his ability to push himself through space while utilizing his [[wind]] [[aura]] to block all sound around him and [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13" /> He then extended his spiritual sense to survey his surroundings.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13" /> During the encounter, Lindon also used [[Blackflame]] to burn off a man's beard.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 14</ref>}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“Wei Shi Lindon,” the First Elder intones, as Lindon moves forward.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c1" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“This one was in search of an ancestral fruit, on behalf of his mother.”<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“One strike each, if it pleases you. First, you take one strike from this one without defense or resistance. Then you strike me in turn. The first to lose his footing is defeated.”<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c5" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“Today, I’ve shown that my ability reaches beyond my level of advancement.”<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c6" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“I’m pleased to have descended personally, Wei Shi Lindon.”<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c11" />}}
